sentences.en: Bringing Bali back to its roots, the Minimizer is an attractive and comfortable bra for the larger busted woman who wants to play down her curves without compromising on beauty.

sentences.en: Looking for the best minimizer bra doesn't have to take you weeks-it doesn't even have to take you days, if you know what to expect.

sentences.en: While some people feel intimidated by the minimizer bra, there are a lot of great options that still leave your bust looking perky and firm.
sentences.vi: Trong khi một số người cảm thấy sợ hãi bởi chiếc áo ngực thu nhỏ, có rất nhiều lựa chọn tuyệt vời mà vẫn giúp vòng ngực của bạn trông săn chắc và đầy đặn.

sentences.en: Are you stumped on the fit of your minimizer bra?

sentences.en: If you are looking for a minimizer bra, try these popular and respected labels for some of the most noticeable results.

sentences.en: Among some of their most popular styles are minimizer bras with a touch of lace along the center cup seam, and front-closure bras for those who prefer that style.
